uditya-kumar/multipath.caption:
What if you could use Wi-Fi AND mobile data at the same time on your PC?

Meet MultiPath - an open-source app that lets your computer use multiple internet connections simultaneously.

It works with Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and USB phone tethering on Windows and Linux.
